polity-38.title: Lokpal and Lokayuktas
polity-38.quality_review: Manual topic-specific review against the complete Core, optional Advanced, routed PYQs, traps and answer architecture.

panels.title: Ombudsman evolution and statutory identity
panels.full_text:
ROOT QUESTION
How can high public office be investigated without merging complaint, police and court?

1809 Sweden -> ombudsman model.
1966 First ARC -> Union Lokpal + State Lokayuktas.
1968 onward -> repeated Bills.
2013 Act -> assent 1 January 2014 -> commencement 16 January 2014.

LEGAL IDENTITY
statutory | corruption-specific | Union institution | no general suo-motu route.

CORE DISTINCTION
Lokpal directs a legal process; the Special Court decides criminal guilt.

panels.title: Composition and eligibility
panels.full_text:
COMPOSITION
Chairperson + not more than eight Members.
50% judicial | at least 50% from named social categories.

ELIGIBILITY
judicial and eminent-person routes have distinct statutory conditions.

TRAP
representation applies to Members; it is not an extra seat count.

panels.title: Selection, tenure and removal
panels.full_text:
SELECTION
PM | Speaker | LoP | CJI/nominee | eminent jurist.
Search Committee assists; President appoints on recommendation.

TENURE
five years or age seventy | no reappointment.

REMOVAL
misbehaviour: President -> Supreme Court inquiry.
Specified direct-removal grounds remain separate.

Common Cause v. Union of India (2017): vacancy did not make the Act unworkable.

panels.title: Jurisdiction over persons and entities
panels.full_text:
PERSONS
PM | Ministers | MPs | Groups A-D | former covered functionaries.

ENTITIES
government-linked bodies and specified donation/foreign-contribution recipients,
subject to statutory thresholds.

TRAP
coverage is conditional; Lokpal has no general private-sector jurisdiction.

panels.title: Prime Minister and parliamentary privilege
panels.full_text:
PM FILTER
excluded domains: international relations | security | public order | atomic energy | space.
Full bench + two-thirds approval | in camera | record controls.

MP RULE
section 14(2) preserves genuine speech/vote functions.
Sita Soren (2024): bribery is not immunised merely because linked to a vote.

panels.title: Complaint and preliminary inquiry
panels.full_text:
PRESCRIBED COMPLAINT
identity + affidavit + particulars + supporting material -> scrutiny.

LOKPAL CHOICE
preliminary inquiry | investigation | lawful closure.

INQUIRY
prima facie screen -> public-servant hearing -> reasoned report.
Inquiry is not investigation and allegation is not guilt.

panels.title: Investigation, prosecution and Special Court
panels.full_text:
INVESTIGATION
CBI/other agency gathers evidence within statutory timelines.

LOKPAL BENCH
closure | departmental action | sanction/prosecution route.

PROSECUTION WING
files and conducts prosecution when directed.

SPECIAL COURT
adjudicates guilt; target one year with recorded extensions, total two years.

panels.title: Inquiry Wing, CVC and CBI interfaces
panels.full_text:
INQUIRY WING
preliminary inquiry and prima facie assessment.

PROSECUTION WING
files and conducts prosecution when Lokpal directs.

CVC ROUTE
specified Groups A-D preliminary-inquiry categories under the statutory distribution.

CBI / DSPE ROUTE
criminal investigation; Lokpal superintendence is confined to Lokpal-referred matters.
Investigating-officer transfer in a referred matter needs Lokpal approval.

VIGILANCE / WHISTLEBLOWER / GRIEVANCE
distinct entry tests and outputs; no automatic jurisdictional substitution.

LIMIT
superintendence != power to dictate a predetermined investigative result.

panels.title: Powers, assets and limitation
panels.full_text:
PROCESS POWERS
search/seizure | civil-court powers | provisional attachment | prosecution sanction.

ATTACHMENT
recorded reasons + suspected corruption proceeds + maximum ninety-day provisional order
-> material sent to Special Court -> confirmation, refusal or later restoration.

SECTION 44
2016 substitution -> assets/liabilities in prescribed form and manner.
Checked official material did not yield a later fresh replacement form-and-manner rule.

LIMITATION
complaint barred after seven years from the alleged offence.

FALSE COMPLAINT
statutory safeguard requires legal proof; it must not deter bona fide disclosures.

Lok Prahari v. Union of India (2018)
electoral disclosure case; it did not restore the pre-2016 Lokpal return format.

panels.title: Lokayuktas and federal diversity
panels.full_text:
SECTION 63
each State shall establish a Lokayukta by State law.

VARIATION AXES
single/member body | selection panel | tenure | jurisdiction | suo-motu power
| minister coverage | investigation support | recommendation/enforcement route.

DO NOT UNIVERSALISE
one State's Governor panel, age, term, Upalokayukta or report consequence.

FEDERAL GAIN
State adaptation and experimentation.

FEDERAL RISK
uneven minimum protection, vacancies and dependence on State agencies.

REFORM
model baseline + State autonomy + transparent appointments + public follow-up.

panels.title: Cases and current legal controls
panels.full_text:
Common Cause v. Union of India (2017) -> Act workable despite committee vacancy.
Lok Prahari v. Union of India (2018) -> electoral disclosure, not section 44 restoration.
Sita Soren (2024) -> bribery outside privilege immunity.

2025 HIGH COURT-JUDGE ISSUE
Supreme Court stayed the Lokpal order; no final merits holding.

CURRENT CLAIMS
use dated primary sources; do not freeze transient statistics.

panels.title: UPSC traps and answer synthesis
panels.full_text:
PRELIMS FIREWALL
statutory, not constitutional | maximum eight Members | PM included with filters
| speech/vote exclusion | no general suo-motu power | seven-year limitation
| referred-case CBI superintendence only | Lokayukta design varies.

2025 PRELIMS ROUTE
jurisdiction + composition -> test percentage denominator, PM safeguards and privilege.

MAINS SPINE
ombudsman evolution -> legal identity -> composition/independence
-> jurisdiction -> complaint-to-court process -> agency interfaces
-> powers and safeguards -> State variation -> capacity reform.

VERDICT
Lokpal has real process powers, but credibility depends on appointments, agency autonomy,
reasoned transparency and court-controlled legality rather than institutional mythology.
